title.en: Giving a quick beginning a direction

paragraphs.en: The horse’s face suggests attention turning toward a path before movement begins. In this original reading, quickness becomes a question about choosing a useful first action. Imagine the difference between opening a gate and running through every open gate. One prepares a route; the other lets opportunity choose for you. You can borrow the image for a particular afternoon without deciding that speed is your permanent nature or that hesitation contradicts your birth star.
paragraphs.zh: 马面可以让人想到先看清路径，再开始移动。本篇把迅速变成一个问题：怎样选出有用的第一步？打开一扇门与逢门就冲进去不同，前者准备路线，后者让机会替自己选择。可以把意象借给某个下午，不必认定速度是终身本性，也无需把犹豫解释为违背出生宿。

paragraphs.en: Suppose you volunteer to organize a neighborhood book exchange. Sending a short message with a proposed date may help everyone begin. Booking a room before checking accessibility, however, can create work that later needs undoing. A useful observation is what your first action makes possible for someone else. Compare one start that clarified the next step with one that merely made you feel busy. The difference concerns preparation and circumstances, rather than a hidden level of courage.
paragraphs.zh: 假设自愿组织社区换书活动，先发一条提议日期的简讯，可能帮助大家启动；没核对无障碍条件就订场地，则可能制造返工。可以观察第一步为别人打开了什么可能。比较一次让下一步清楚的开场与一次只是让自己觉得忙碌的开场，差别在准备和条件，不在隐藏的勇气等级。

paragraphs.en: When several people share the task, an early mover can leave a clear handoff: what was tried, what remains undecided and who may choose the next step. That keeps initiative from becoming a demand for everyone to match one pace. A friend who checks the budget slowly may be protecting the same project. Asking which decision actually needs to happen today makes room for both contributions. Permission to begin does not automatically include permission to commit other people’s time.
paragraphs.zh: 多人合作时，先行动的人可以留下清楚交接：试了什么、还有什么未决定、谁来选下一步。这样主动不会变成要求所有人跟同一速度。慢慢核预算的朋友可能也在保护项目；问清今天究竟必须决定什么，能容纳两种贡献。允许发起，不等于允许替别人承诺时间。

title.en: A counterexample that changes the reading

paragraphs.en: A counterexample is a person who appears fast only because they have practiced that task for years. The same person may need a long pause in unfamiliar work. Another is someone who waits because access, money or permission is missing. Calling either pattern an inborn quick or slow temperament loses the conditions that explain it. If the horse image feels attractive, look for a situation where waiting improved the outcome as well as one where a prompt start helped.
paragraphs.zh: 一种反例是多年练习让人看起来动作很快，换到陌生任务，同一个人可能需要长时间停顿。另一种是资源、资金或许可不足才等待。把这些归为天生快慢，会丢掉真正解释行为的条件。若喜欢马的意象，既找一次及时开始有帮助的例子，也找一次等待改善结果的例子。

paragraphs.en: For an optional experiment, choose a harmless task you already want to begin, such as labeling a folder. Write one first action and one condition that would make you stop and check. After trying it, note whether the action reduced uncertainty or simply increased motion. There is no target speed, daily streak or need to repeat the exercise. A useful result may be that the task was not yours to start, or that asking a question was the most effective beginning.
paragraphs.zh: 可选一个本来就想开始的无害小事，例如给文件夹加标签，写下一步行动和一个需要停下来核对的条件。试后观察：行动减少了不确定，还是只增加了动作？没有目标速度、每日打卡或必须重复的要求。发现任务不该由自己发起，或提问才是最有效开场，同样有用。

paragraphs.en: For a known birth instant, this calculator transforms the geometric geocentric Moon and a fixed J2000 Spica catalogue direction into the same true ecliptic of date. It subtracts the Spica longitude and adds 180°, then wraps the answer into 0–360°. The unrounded value selects one of 27 equal 13°20′ sectors. Ashwini occupies sector 1; the displayed pada is one of its four equal subdivisions. Within 0.25° of a mansion edge both adjacent full readings appear. That comparison window is a website policy, not a confidence interval, and does not resolve an inaccurate birth record.

An astronomical position does not establish an instinct, a hidden identity or a future event. This fixed-Spica approximation omits stellar proper motion, aberration and parallax and is not certified as exact Lahiri, Swiss True Chitra or an IMD almanac. A birthplace-specific historical IANA zone is needed to resolve local time; coordinates do not enter this geocentric model. Unknown time receives no substitute noon. No health, marriage, ability or career conclusion follows from this guide. All 27 readings stay open without entering birth details.

title.zh: 留出承载空间，也看见容量

paragraphs.en: The selected generative-form image can be approached through the idea of making room for something to develop. This is a cultural metaphor, not an instruction about bodies, reproduction or gender. A room has edges and a container has capacity. In this original reading, carrying a responsibility includes recognizing what cannot fit. The useful question is what conditions allow a chosen commitment to grow without assuming that you must hold every request, emotion or unfinished task that arrives.
paragraphs.zh: 所选生育形象可以从为事物发展留空间来理解，这是文化比喻，不是关于身体、繁衍或性别的指令。房间有边界，容器有容量。本篇把承担责任也理解为看见装不下的部分：什么条件能让主动选择的承诺发展，而不假定所有请求、情绪与未完任务都必须由自己承载？

paragraphs.en: Imagine agreeing to care for a friend’s plants during a trip. The agreement becomes workable when the number of visits, watering instructions and return date are clear. Quietly adding pet care, deliveries and household repairs changes the commitment. Looking at capacity before saying yes is part of care rather than a failure of generosity. Compare what you explicitly accepted with what you later assumed. The plant example concerns an ordinary agreement; it does not reveal a biological or spiritual role you were born to fulfill.
paragraphs.zh: 想象答应朋友旅行时照看植物。讲清探访次数、浇水说明与归期，承诺才可执行；悄悄加上照顾宠物、收快递和维修，责任就变了。答应前核对容量也是照顾的一部分。可以比较明确接受了什么，后来又自行加了什么。这是普通约定，不揭示与生俱来的生物或灵性角色。

paragraphs.en: In a shared project, support is easier to sustain when people can name the work and renegotiate it. Someone who keeps the meeting notes may also be carrying reminders, emotional reassurance and follow-up messages that nobody has counted. Invite a description of that work without assigning it to the most accommodating person. A clear limit can make room for another person’s contribution. Consent to one task remains specific; an affectionate relationship does not convert it into unlimited availability.
paragraphs.zh: 共同项目中，把工作说清并允许重新商量，支持才容易持续。记会议记录的人可能还默默承担提醒、安抚与追问，这些劳动未被计算。可以请大家描述工作，不自动交给最容易答应的人。清楚的限度能留出别人参与的位置；同意一项任务是具体的，亲密关系不使它变成无限待命。

Another is someone who declines a request while already supporting a different commitment. Neither observation establishes selfishness or exceptional strength. The metaphor becomes less useful when it praises endurance without checking cost. If a story about carrying resonates, include the resources, help and permission to refuse that made the responsibility possible, rather than crediting a birth label for the entire outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 承载意象的反例之一，是别人看不到已经放弃的事情，才误以为某人无所不能；另一个是拒绝请求的人其实正在支持别的承诺。两者都不能证明自私或特别坚强。只赞美忍耐、不看成本，比喻就失去帮助。若承载故事引起共鸣，也把资源、协助和拒绝权写进去，而不把全部结果归功于出生标签。

Add one sentence describing how a change would be discussed. You do not need to confront anyone or withdraw support to complete the exercise. Simply noticing an undefined ending may be enough. The aim is to make a real agreement visible, not to prove a caring identity. If the symbol feels too personal or unhelpful, choose another public guide without treating that choice as resistance.

title.zh: 分清需要保留与调整的部分

paragraphs.en: A razor works through a narrow, controlled edge. As a metaphor here, it suggests distinguishing what belongs in a task from what can be removed. Precision depends on the purpose, the material and the skill of the person handling it. It does not require treating people as obstacles. This original reading asks how an edit serves its intended audience, and what should remain intact. The traditional symbol is not evidence that a person is naturally severe, dangerous or unusually decisive.
paragraphs.zh: 剃刀靠狭窄且受控的刃口工作，本篇借它区分任务中需要保留与可以删去的内容。精细判断依赖目的、材料与操作技能，无需把人当障碍。可以问修改怎样服务读者，以及什么应完整保留。传统符号不能证明一个人天生严厉、危险或格外果断。

paragraphs.en: Suppose you are shortening an invitation so it fits on a small card. Removing a repeated sentence may improve clarity; removing the accessible entrance information may make the card less useful. The test is what the reader needs to act, rather than how much text disappears. Try describing the reason for one deletion in ordinary language. If you cannot explain its benefit, keeping the sentence temporarily may be the more careful choice. A clean-looking page is only one part of a successful invitation.
paragraphs.zh: 假设把邀请函压缩到小卡片，删掉重复句可能更清楚，删掉无障碍入口信息却可能降低实用性。判断依据是读者需要什么才能行动，而不是删了多少字。试着用普通语言解释一次删除的理由；说不出益处，暂时保留可能更谨慎。页面看起来干净只是邀请成功的一部分。

paragraphs.en: When reviewing another person’s work, separate the shared goal from your preferred style. A colleague may need a factual correction, while a different phrase merely sounds less familiar to you. Naming the distinction lets the author respond without guessing which comments are essential. paragraphs.en: For a group activity, logistics includes the people doing the carrying. Someone must transport materials, hold keys, explain access and take things home afterward. Make those tasks visible before calling a plan easy. A person who suggests a smaller event may understand the route better, rather than care less about the goal. Sharing the load can mean reducing it, dividing it or changing the destination. Ask which arrangement each participant can actually sustain instead of assuming that enthusiasm supplies unlimited time and energy.

paragraphs.en: A deer’s raised head can suggest noticing something beyond the current path. This original reading treats that movement as curiosity with an orientation point: where did the question begin, and what would count as learning enough for now? An interesting detail need not become a new obligation. You can explore one branch and return. The image offers a way to examine attention without concluding that a birth position makes you restless, sensitive, clever or unable to finish what you start.

paragraphs.en: Imagine looking for a recipe for a shared meal and becoming interested in the history of one ingredient. That detour may enrich the conversation, but the immediate task still needs quantities and allergy information. Keep a note of the historical question and return to the practical list. Later you can decide whether to follow it further. The useful distinction is between information for today’s decision and information you enjoy exploring, not between a disciplined person and a supposedly wandering personality.

That makes exploration shareable and lets others check it. A conversation does not become more thoughtful simply because one participant asks the most questions or collects the most unusual facts.

Other familiar accounts use a tear or storm image; this page does not silently merge those traditions. Here the original reflection concerns changing light and revisiting an interpretation. The aim can be a workable next conversation rather than a dramatic revelation.

title.en: Making a return that allows change

paragraphs.en: The house variant chosen for Punarvasu brings attention to shelter, return and the arrangement of a familiar place. Returning does not require recreating every old detail. paragraphs.en: Imagine opening a sketchbook after a long break. Resuming the old plan of one finished page every day may make the return feel impossible. Setting out pencils and drawing one small object could be enough to discover what still interests you. Notice which part of the earlier practice you want and which belonged to different circumstances. The return may lead somewhere new. A partially filled notebook is not evidence that you failed an essential calling or need to recover a lost authentic self.

New members, revised agreements and different availability deserve attention rather than an assumption that everything is as before. Ask what role the returning person wants now, and do not make gratitude a condition of belonging. The house metaphor can support hospitality when there is room to choose where to sit. It becomes restrictive if an old role is presented as the only available place or a relationship as a debt that must be repaid.

title.en: Aiming support at a concrete need

paragraphs.en: The arrow variant selected for Pushya suggests a direction and an intended point of arrival. Many other accounts choose an udder or flower; this page retains its cited variant rather than calling all images identical. The original theme here is support with a concrete purpose. Where is the help meant to land, and who gets to define that need? A clear aim can be useful without proving that someone is born to nourish others or that every caring act should be efficient, measurable or welcomed.

paragraphs.en: Suppose a neighbor is preparing for a move. You could bring boxes, carry furniture, cook a meal or simply keep an agreed doorway clear. Asking which would help most may be more useful than choosing the most impressive gesture. The answer might be a task you cannot offer, which gives both people information for another plan. Compare your intention with the practical need described by the neighbor. Good intentions matter to an account of the interaction, but they do not determine whether the help arrived where it was needed.

Their choice may change the direction. Support can remain meaningful when it is smaller, less visible or different from the role you expected to play.

The answer may involve time, company, privacy or a simple permission to leave. None of these conditions follows from a birth star. The symbol does not establish charm, romantic success, artistic talent or a fixed preference for leisure. It can make an ordinary invitation easier to examine without making pleasure into a duty or a proof of personal worth.

paragraphs.en: Imagine inviting two friends to listen to music at home. A comfortable evening may need fewer plans than you first expected: a clear start time, something to sit on and agreement that nobody must stay late. paragraphs.en: In a group, enjoyment is not identical for every participant. One person may like games, another conversation, and another a break from being asked to participate. Make an invitation specific enough to understand and loose enough to decline. A host does not need to manage everyone’s mood, and a guest does not owe visible enthusiasm. Sharing a couch is a useful metaphor only when people can choose their distance and duration. Notice practical access, cost and sensory conditions before interpreting reluctance as a personality difference or lack of affection.
paragraphs.zh: 团体里每个人的愉快不同：有人喜欢游戏，有人喜欢交谈，有人需要不被催参与。邀请应具体到能理解，也允许拒绝；主人无需管理所有人的心情，客人也不欠显著热情。共坐一榻只有在距离与时长可选时才是有用比喻。解释迟疑前，也看出入条件、费用与感官环境，不急着归为性格或感情不足。

paragraphs.en: A counterexample is rest that looks pleasant from outside but is actually waiting, illness or exhaustion. Another is a lively event that someone attends from obligation rather than enjoyment. The visible activity cannot establish the person’s inner experience. If this image appeals to you, recall a modest pleasure that did not need witnesses and an apparently enjoyable occasion that did not fit. title.en: Letting a finished detail serve the whole

paragraphs.en: A pearl draws attention to a small visible form that can be appreciated in its setting. This original reading asks how a detail contributes to a whole. A careful finish may make work easier to use or simply make it pleasing to its maker. Both can matter, but neither establishes personal perfection. The image does not prove beauty, charisma, artistic ability or a special destiny. You can examine a particular act of making without treating every unfinished edge as evidence about your identity or the value of your work.

paragraphs.en: Suppose you are making a simple map for visitors to a community event. Choosing legible labels may matter more than adding another decorative border. A small visual detail can still help people recognize the entrance or distinguish two rooms. Test the map with someone unfamiliar with the building and listen to where they hesitate. The best finish depends on its use. A beautiful image that sends people to the wrong door needs revision, while a plain map that works may already be ready to share.
paragraphs.zh: 为社区活动画访客地图时，清楚标签可能比再加装饰边框更重要，小视觉细节也可帮助认入口或区分房间。可以请不熟悉建筑的人看图，听哪里犹豫。怎样收尾取决于用途：漂亮却把人带错门的图需要改，朴素但好用的图可能已可分享。

paragraphs.en: In collaborative work, visible polish often rests on less visible contributions. Someone checked the facts, gathered materials, maintained the tools or made the time available. Naming those contributions keeps admiration for the finished object from erasing the process. Agree on what ready means before one person spends hours refining a detail others do not need. Feedback can distinguish a factual problem, an access problem and a matter of taste. The pearl image is useful when attention to form supports shared purpose rather than making one person’s preferred finish the only acceptable standard.

The task, audience, available time and consequences of an error provide better evidence for deciding how much finish is useful.

Equally, choosing your own route does not remove shared responsibilities such as returning borrowed tools. Explain the part that affects others and keep private the parts that do not need agreement. The coral image can remind you that a distinct outline may still depend on connection. Autonomy works through specific choices and mutual conditions, rather than a performance of never needing anyone.

paragraphs.en: A gateway marks a transition without explaining what lies beyond it. In this original reading, an aim becomes clearer when you examine both the entrance and the next room. Getting through a visible threshold can be satisfying, but it may be only the beginning of a different task. The image does not establish ambition, success or a need to prove yourself. Ask what you want the crossing to make possible and which conditions would make staying outside the gate a reasonable choice for now.
paragraphs.zh: 门廊标记过渡，却不说明门后是什么。本篇把目标放在入口和下一间房里一起看：跨过显眼门槛令人满足，也可能只是另一任务的开始。意象不证明野心、成功或必须证明自己的需求。可以问跨过后希望获得什么，以及什么条件下暂留门外也合理。

paragraphs.en: Suppose you are considering a short evening course. Acceptance is one threshold; travel, schedule, cost and the kind of practice offered determine whether the course fits your week. Reading the syllabus may be more useful than imagining the certificate. Compare the skill you want to use with what participants actually do. You can be interested and still decide the timing is wrong. The gateway metaphor helps organize that practical choice without turning enrollment into a test of courage or declining into a failure of determination.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑晚间短课程时，录取是一道门，交通、时间、费用和练习方式才决定是否适合本周生活。看课程说明可能比想象证书有用；可比较希望用到的技能与学员实际做的事。感兴趣也可以认为时机不对，门廊比喻整理选择，不把报名变成勇气考试或拒绝视作缺乏决心。

paragraphs.en: When inviting someone into a project, describe what participation involves beyond the attractive opening. A clear welcome includes the expected work, available support and a route to leave or renegotiate. Do not assume that agreement with a goal means agreement with every method. People may share the destination while needing different access arrangements. The gateway image works best when the entrance is understandable and genuinely optional. Ask what information another person would need to choose, rather than treating hesitation as something to overcome through persuasion or a symbolic account of their personality.
paragraphs.zh: 邀请别人加入项目时，应说明吸引人的开场之后还有什么：预期工作、支持、退出或重谈路径。认同目标不等于认同所有方法，共同目的也可需要不同参与条件。门廊意象应让入口可理解且真正可选；可以问对方需要哪些信息才能选择，不把迟疑当成要靠劝说或性格解释克服的障碍。

title.en: A counterexample that changes the reading

paragraphs.en: A counterexample is a person who reaches an impressive milestone and discovers that the activity afterward does not suit them. title.en: Following a trace without forcing a cause
title.zh: 沿线索追查，不强填原因

paragraphs.en: The lion’s-tail variant selected for Mula can suggest following a visible part toward a larger, partly unseen context. Other accounts use roots; this page does not silently replace the cited figure with that more familiar symbol. The original reflection is about tracing a problem carefully. A clue can guide a question without proving a cause. The image does not establish a destructive temperament, unusual investigative talent or a duty to uncover hidden truths. Ask what evidence is available and what would justify ending the inquiry for now.
paragraphs.zh: Mula在此采用狮尾变体，可以想象沿可见部分走向较大且尚未全见的背景。其他叙述会用根，本页不悄悄换成更熟悉的符号。原创主题是谨慎追查问题：线索可以引导提问，却不证明原因。意象不证明破坏性格、特殊侦查才能或必须揭开秘密的义务，应问证据在哪里、何时可暂时停止。

paragraphs.en: Suppose a shared printer stops producing readable pages. The last person to use it is a visible clue, but the cause might be an empty cartridge, a changed setting or a damaged cable. Checking one ordinary condition at a time can be more useful than constructing a personal explanation. Record what actually changed after a check. If the cause remains unclear, label it unclear. The practical goal is a working printer or a sensible request for help, not a dramatic account of who is to blame.
paragraphs.zh: 共享打印机突然打印不清，最后使用者是可见线索，原因却可能是墨盒、设置或线缆。逐项核对普通条件，可能比编造个人解释有用；记录核对后实际改变了什么。仍不清楚就承认不清楚，目标是设备可用或合理求助，不是写出谁该受责的戏剧故事。

paragraphs.en: When a problem involves people, investigation needs permission and proportion. Ask about a shared event without claiming access to someone’s private messages or history. Distinguish a description of what happened from an explanation of why another person acted. They may correct your account or decline to discuss more. A group can often improve a process without settling every motive. The tail image supports following evidence when it also preserves a stopping point. Curiosity does not create entitlement to another person’s story, and a symbolic guide cannot establish concealed intentions.
paragraphs.zh: 问题涉及人时，追查需要许可与分寸。可询问共同事件，不因此索取私人消息或经历；分开发生了什么与自己解释对方为何行动，对方可纠正或不再讨论。团体常能在不查清每个动机时改善流程。狮尾意象应既跟随证据，也保留停止点；好奇不产生占有别人故事的权利，符号不能证明隐瞒意图。

title.en: A counterexample that changes the reading

paragraphs.en: A counterexample is a problem with several interacting causes rather than one hidden root. Another is an apparent pattern that disappears when more cases are included. A satisfying explanation can be wrong, and an incomplete explanation can be the most accurate account currently available. If this image appeals to you, recall a time you revised an explanation after a new fact appeared. Also include a case where acting on a modest known condition helped before the full cause was established. Inquiry and practical repair do not always need to finish in the same order.
paragraphs.zh: 问题可能有多个相互作用的原因，而非一个隐藏根源；增加案例后，表面模式也可能消失。令人满意的解释可以错，不完整解释却可能最准确。可回想新事实出现后修订解释的一次，也纳入原因未全明前，先处理一个已知小条件就有帮助的一次。调查和修复不总需要按同一顺序结束。

paragraphs.en: An optional experiment is to take a harmless recurring inconvenience and write three possible explanations, including one about the environment. Mark which observations would distinguish them and choose at most one easy check. Stop if the next step would require private information, disproportionate effort or a decision you are not authorized to make. You can simply keep the question open. The aim is clearer uncertainty, without a requirement to solve everything. A useful result may be replacing a confident personal story with a smaller statement about what you actually know.
paragraphs.zh: 可为一种无害不便写三个可能解释，包括一个环境因素，标出什么观察能区分它们，最多选一项容易核对的。如果下一步需要私人信息、不成比例的努力或无权作的决定，就停止，也可以保持开放问题。目的在于更清楚的不确定，不要求解决一切；把自信的个人故事缩小为实际所知，也有用。

Mula occupies sector 19; the displayed pada is one of its four equal subdivisions. Within 0.25° of a mansion edge both adjacent full readings appear. That comparison window is a website policy, not a confidence interval, and does not resolve an inaccurate birth record.

An astronomical position does not establish an instinct, a hidden identity or a future event. This fixed-Spica approximation omits stellar proper motion, aberration and parallax and is not certified as exact Lahiri, Swiss True Chitra or an IMD almanac. A birthplace-specific historical IANA zone is needed to resolve local time; coordinates do not enter this geocentric model. Unknown time receives no substitute noon. No health, marriage, ability or career conclusion follows from this guide. All 27 readings stay open without entering birth details.

paragraphs.en: The traditional tusk image can be read as a visible point of strength. This original reflection asks what makes a position sturdy without making it impossible to revise. Conviction may rest on preparation, a clear reason or support from others. It need not be displayed as force. The symbol does not establish invincibility, persuasive power or a right to win a dispute. A view remains useful when it can answer questions about its purpose, evidence and consequences, rather than relying on the confidence with which it is expressed.

paragraphs.en: Imagine proposing a different meeting time because the current one excludes several participants. A well-supported case might include the actual availability and a workable alternative. Repeating the proposal more loudly adds little if those details are missing. After hearing a new scheduling constraint, you may keep the aim while changing the specific time. Notice the difference between holding the purpose and defending every first detail. The practical outcome is a meeting people can attend, not proof that you are a determined person who never gives ground.

State the part you regard as important and the part you can negotiate. Clear boundaries can coexist with a change of method. The tusk image becomes less useful if every exchange is treated as a contest. A conversation can end with a smaller agreement, a request for more information or a respectful acknowledgment that the available options do not yet fit.
paragraphs.zh: 意见不同时，应允许对方用自己的方式描述问题，不同路径假设可能遮住共同目的。可以说明重视的部分与可商量的部分，清楚边界可与方法变化共存。如果每次交流都成竞赛，象牙意象便无益。对话可以以较小共识、补信息请求，或承认现有选项尚不合适结束。

title.en: Giving a principle a usable foundation
title.zh: 让原则有可使用的基础

paragraphs.en: A platform supports something by remaining steady enough for its purpose. In this original reading, the image becomes a question about the practical foundations of a principle. Saying that something matters is different from arranging a repeatable way to honor it. Ask what action the principle requires and what conditions make that action possible. The symbol does not establish moral superiority, inevitable victory or authority to judge another person. A standard can be dependable while still allowing questions about access, exceptions and circumstances that were not anticipated when it was made.
paragraphs.zh: 台座通过足以满足用途的稳定性提供支撑。本篇借它问原则的实际基础：说一件事重要，与安排可重复践行方式不同。可以问原则要求什么行动，什么条件让行动可能。符号不证明道德优越、必胜或评判他人的权威。标准可以可靠，同时允许讨论可用条件、例外与制定时未预见的情境。

paragraphs.en: Suppose a club says every member should have a chance to speak. A usable foundation might be an agenda shared in advance, a way to submit written comments and a chair who leaves time for replies. Merely repeating the value does not supply those arrangements. Compare the stated principle with the actual meeting. A small procedural change can matter more than a grand declaration. The example concerns a particular shared practice; it does not identify who is naturally fair or who deserves a permanent role as the group’s moral center.
paragraphs.zh: 社团宣称每位成员应有发言机会，可用基础可能是提前发议程、允许书面意见，以及主持人留答复时间。反复喊价值不会自动提供安排。可比较宣言与真实会议，小流程变化可能胜过宏大表态。这是具体共同做法，不识别谁天生公平，或谁应永久担任团体道德中心。

paragraphs.en: When applying a standard to other people, explain it in terms they can act on. Check whether everyone has the resources and information needed to meet it. An exception may reveal a flaw in the procedure rather than a failure of character. Invite a review without making the person affected responsible for redesigning everything. The platform image is useful when stability serves participation. It becomes restrictive when protecting the appearance of consistency matters more than noticing an avoidable obstacle. A fair revision should be understandable to those affected, including people who followed the earlier rule.
paragraphs.zh: 把标准用于他人时，应解释到可行动，并检查是否都有资源与信息满足它。例外可能揭示流程缺陷，不是人品失败；可以邀请复查，不把全部重设计责任交给受影响者。台座稳定应服务参与，若为维护一致外观而忽略可避免障碍，就会限制人。公平修订也应让遵守旧规则的人理解。

title.en: A counterexample that changes the reading

paragraphs.en: A counterexample is a rule applied identically that produces different burdens because circumstances differ. Another is a flexible arrangement that reliably protects the same underlying purpose. Consistency of wording and consistency of care are not always the same. If this image appeals to you, recall a standard that helped and one that needed revision. Describe the particular consequences instead of sorting people into principled and unprincipled types. A birth position cannot resolve an ethical disagreement or replace the facts and affected people needed to evaluate a decision.
paragraphs.zh: 同一规则因条件不同产生不同负担，是一种反例；灵活安排也可能持续保护相同目的。措辞一致与实际照顾一致不总相同。可以各记一项有用标准与一项需要修订的标准，描述具体后果，不把人分为有原则和无原则。出生落点不能解决伦理分歧，也不能代替判断所需事实与受影响者。

paragraphs.en: For an optional experiment, take one ordinary principle you already value and write a single observable practice that supports it. Then name one practical barrier and one way the practice could be reviewed. You do not need a new rulebook or a promise to act perfectly. The exercise gives an abstract statement a small foundation. paragraphs.en: A circle marks an inside and an outside while leaving the question of access to the people using the space. This original reading treats a boundary as an arrangement with a purpose, not a judgment about who is good or bad. A boundary can protect concentration, privacy or a limited resource. Ask what belongs inside for this task and how an opening is agreed. The symbol does not establish secrecy, isolation, medical insight or healing ability, and this guide does not turn traditional associations into claims about health or recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 圆圈标出内外，谁可进入仍由使用空间的人决定。本篇把边界看作有目的的安排，不评判谁好谁坏；它可以保护专注、隐私或有限资源。可以问本任务哪些属于圈内、入口怎样约定。符号不证明秘密、孤立、医学洞见或疗愈能力，本指南也不把传统联想变成健康或康复主张。

paragraphs.en: Imagine keeping a shared notebook for a volunteer project. Some pages contain public plans, while a separate private note contains contact details supplied for one purpose. A clear distinction helps people use the useful information without circulating everything. The boundary is practical: who needs which detail, for what reason and for how long? It does not require suspicion of every participant. The circle image is useful when it makes a real information choice clearer rather than giving a dramatic explanation of why someone is naturally guarded or mysterious.
paragraphs.zh: 志愿项目共享本子里，有公开计划，另有只为某目的提供的私人联系方式。分清两者，能使用有用信息而不传播所有内容。边界问题很实际：谁为何需要哪些细节、保留多久？无需怀疑每位成员，圆圈应让真实信息选择更清楚，不编造天生戒备或神秘的解释。

paragraphs.en: In a relationship or group, a boundary is easier to understand when it names an action you can control. Saying when you will answer messages differs from demanding that nobody ever feel disappointed. An opening can be specific, such as a scheduled time to discuss a shared task. Other people can respond with their own limits. The circle metaphor supports mutual clarity when it leaves room for negotiation where appropriate and a genuine refusal where needed. It cannot determine whether another person’s behavior is safe or replace practical evidence about the situation.
paragraphs.zh: 关系或团体中，边界若说明自己能控制的行动，更易理解。说明何时回消息，不同于要求别人永不失望；入口也可具体为约定讨论共同任务的时间。对方也可提出自己的限度。圆圈应帮助相互清楚，在适合处商量，在需要处允许拒绝，不能裁定他人行为是否安全或替代实际证据。

title.en: A counterexample that changes the reading

paragraphs.en: A counterexample is an apparent private preference caused by a lack of accessible space or time. Another is a person who shares freely in one setting and keeps details private in another because the purposes differ. Neither proves an inconsistent or secretive personality. If the circle image resonates, include an occasion when opening a channel helped and one when keeping information limited was appropriate. The quality of a boundary depends on its actual purpose and effect. A birth star cannot tell you whom to trust, what to disclose or whether a health concern needs attention.
paragraphs.zh: 看似偏好独处，可能只是缺少可用空间或时间；同一个人在一处分享很多、另一处保留信息，也可能因目的不同。两者不证明性格矛盾或神秘。可以同时纳入开放渠道有帮助与限制信息合适的例子。边界质量取决于真实目的和效果，出生宿不能告诉人该信谁、披露什么，或健康疑虑需不需要处理。

paragraphs.en: For an optional experiment, choose a harmless piece of project information and write who needs it, why and where it should be kept. Do not use private medical details or another person’s confidential story for the exercise. You can notice an existing good arrangement rather than changing anything. The aim is to make one modest boundary understandable. If the answer depends on an agreement you do not know, ask or leave it unresolved. There is no score for openness, privacy or the size of the circle you prefer.
paragraphs.zh: 可选一条无害的项目信息，写谁需要、为何需要、应放哪里，不用私人医疗细节或他人机密故事做练习。也可只发现已有好安排，不必改动。目的在于让一个小边界易懂；若依赖自己不知道的约定，就询问或保留未解决。开放、隐私与偏好圈子大小都不评分。

paragraphs.en: For a known birth instant, this calculator transforms the geometric geocentric Moon and a fixed J2000 Spica catalogue direction into the same true ecliptic of date. It subtracts the Spica longitude and adds 180°, then wraps the answer into 0–360°. The unrounded value selects one of 27 equal 13°20′ sectors. Shatabhisha occupies sector 24; the displayed pada is one of its four equal subdivisions. Within 0.25° of a mansion edge both adjacent full readings appear. That comparison window is a website policy, not a confidence interval, and does not resolve an inaccurate birth record.

An astronomical position does not establish an instinct, a hidden identity or a future event. This fixed-Spica approximation omits stellar proper motion, aberration and parallax and is not certified as exact Lahiri, Swiss True Chitra or an IMD almanac. A birthplace-specific historical IANA zone is needed to resolve local time; coordinates do not enter this geocentric model. Unknown time receives no substitute noon. No health, marriage, ability or career conclusion follows from this guide. All 27 readings stay open without entering birth details.

paragraphs.en: A cot can provide a temporary place to rest while a longer arrangement is still being made. This original reading uses the selected image for the beginning of a transition. paragraphs.en: Imagine a community reading group changing its usual venue. A borrowed room for one meeting may be enough while a suitable permanent place is checked. Some participants may need an alternative rather than the same bridge. The image supports cooperation when uncertainty is named and people retain a choice. It becomes less useful if a provisional plan is used to postpone decisions indefinitely or to demand gratitude from those inconvenienced by the transition.

title.en: Holding two perspectives without losing the facts
title.zh: 容纳两个视角，也守住事实

paragraphs.en: Two faces in a traditional figure can invite a comparison between viewpoints. This original reading keeps that invitation separate from an accusation about being two-faced. People may see different parts of the same event, hold more than one role or change an opinion after learning more. Ask what each perspective makes visible and which facts remain common. The symbol does not establish duplicity, hidden wisdom or an unusual depth of character. A cultural image can help organize a comparison without claiming to reveal a private self beneath a public one.
paragraphs.zh: 传统形象中的双面可以邀请比较视角，本篇不把它变成“两面人”的指责。人可能看见同一事件不同部分、承担多个角色，或因新信息改想法。可以问各视角揭示什么、哪些事实共同。符号不证明欺骗、隐藏智慧或特别深度，也不声称揭开公开面孔下的私人真我。

paragraphs.en: Imagine two people describing a noisy shared workspace. One values the conversations that help solve problems; another needs quiet to finish a detailed task. Both accounts can be accurate without making the conditions equally suitable for each person. List the observed sounds, the tasks and the times involved before choosing an arrangement. A quiet period and a separate discussion area might address more of the problem than deciding who is sociable or sensitive. The two-faces image is useful when it makes the actual perspectives clearer rather than reducing them to opposing personality types.
paragraphs.zh: 两人描述嘈杂共享工作空间时，一人珍视帮助解题的交谈，另一人需要安静完成细节任务。两者都可准确，却不表示环境同样适合。可以先列声音、任务与时段，再选安排；安静时段与独立讨论区可能比判定谁合群谁敏感更有用。双面应让实际视角更清楚，不缩成人格对立。

paragraphs.en: In a disagreement, understanding another account does not require accepting every claim. Ask for a concrete example and distinguish an observed event from an inference about intention. You can summarize what you understand and name the part still disputed. That gives both people a chance to correct the comparison. The image supports perspective taking when it also allows evidence to rule out an inaccurate account. Giving two views equal space is a conversational choice; it is not proof that both are equally supported or that a compromise is always appropriate.
paragraphs.zh: 分歧中理解另一个说法，不要求接受每项主张。可请举具体例子，分开观察到的事件与动机推断，再摘要所理解部分与仍争议部分，让双方能纠正比较。换位也要允许证据排除错误说法；给予两种观点同等表达空间是交流选择，不证明证据同样充分，也不意味着总应折中。

These require different responses. If the image resonates, recall one disagreement resolved by checking information and one managed by allowing separate choices. You do not need to uncover a deeper contradiction in yourself or another person. Multiple perspectives can be ordinary consequences of access, role and preference. A birth star cannot determine which account is true or justify dismissing someone as secretly inconsistent.

An astronomical position does not establish an instinct, a hidden identity or a future event. This fixed-Spica approximation omits stellar proper motion, aberration and parallax and is not certified as exact Lahiri, Swiss True Chitra or an IMD almanac. A birthplace-specific historical IANA zone is needed to resolve local time; coordinates do not enter this geocentric model. Unknown time receives no substitute noon. No health, marriage, ability or career conclusion follows from this guide. All 27 readings stay open without entering birth details.
paragraphs.zh: 把Uttara Bhadrapada意象用作比较具体情境的邀请，也纳入不吻合的例子。天文位置不能证明本能、隐藏身份或未来事件。本版固定角宿一近似省略恒星自行、光行差和视差，不声称等同精确Lahiri、Swiss True Chitra或印度气象局历书。当地时间须用出生地当时适用的IANA时区解析；经纬度不参与这一地心模型。未知时间不代填中午。这篇指南不推导健康、婚姻、能力或职业结论；全部27篇无需输入出生资料即可阅读。

title.en: Revati: marking an ending that carries information forward
title.zh: Revati：让结束把有用信息带向下一步

headline.zh: Revati · 鼓 · Deva gana · 水星（Vimshottari）

summary.en: This edition uses the cited drum variant of Revati. Explore completion, a clear handoff and what can reasonably be left behind, without predicting a journey or destiny.
summary.zh: 本版采用所引资料中Revati的鼓变体，探索完成、清楚交接与可合理留下的部分，不预测旅程或命运。

title.en: Revati Nakshatra: Symbol, Gana and Cultural Reading
title.zh: Revati出生宿：符号、gana与文化读法

description.en: This edition uses the cited drum variant of Revati. Explore completion, a clear handoff and what can reasonably be left behind, without predicting a journey or destiny.
description.zh: 本版采用所引资料中Revati的鼓变体，探索完成、清楚交接与可合理留下的部分，不预测旅程或命运。

scoreReading.en: A complete public cultural reading, without anyone’s birth details or calculated position. The traditional labels are source facts; the scenes, counterexamples and optional observations are original reflections. They are not a personality score, diagnosis, compatibility verdict or forecast.
scoreReading.zh: 这是一篇完整公开文化读法，不含任何人的出生资料或计算落点。传统标签来自注明的资料，场景、反例与可选观察为原创反思，不是人格分数、诊断、配对裁决或预测。

paragraphs.en: Revati is number 27 in the 27 equal-sector sequence used here. The selected teaching-source symbol is a drum; its traditional gana is Deva, and its Vimshottari ruler is Mercury. These are different cultural categories, not measured traits. A ruler is not the deity or the ruler of a zodiac sign. Gana does not grade someone’s goodness, gender or social standing. The following scenes are FermatMind’s original way of exploring this selected image, rather than quotations or universal traditional personality rules. Other traditions may use a different symbol; this page keeps the cited IGNOU variant explicit.
paragraphs.zh: Revati是这里采用的27等分序列中的第27宿。所选教材符号为鼓，传统gana分类为Deva，Vimshottari主星为水星。三者属于不同文化类别，不是测量出的特质；主星不能与神祇或星座主星混用。Gana不评定人品、性别或社会等级。以下场景是费马围绕所选意象编写的原创探索，不是教材引文或放之四海皆准的传统性格定律。 其他传统可能采用不同符号；本页明确保留所引IGNOU教材的这一变体。

title.en: Marking an ending that carries information forward
title.zh: 让结束把有用信息带向下一步

paragraphs.en: A drum can make a transition audible: a pattern ends, attention shifts and another activity can begin. This original reading gives the selected Revati drum variant a theme of completion and handoff. Other accounts often choose fish; the cited figure is kept explicit here. The focus differs from coordinating an ongoing rhythm. Ask what signals that a task is finished and what information the next person needs. The symbol does not establish protection, safe travel, wealth or a destined final stage in someone’s life.
paragraphs.zh: 鼓可以让过渡被听见：一段模式结束，注意转移，另一活动开始。本篇给所选Revati鼓变体安排完成与交接主题；其他叙述常用鱼，本页明确保留所引形象。它与持续协调节奏不同，可以问什么标记任务完成、下一人需要什么信息。符号不证明保护、旅途平安、财富或生命注定终章。

paragraphs.en: Imagine finishing a small shared photo album. The useful ending may include a clear file name, permission about sharing and a note about images still waiting for a caption. Perfecting every page indefinitely can keep others from using it. On the other hand, declaring it finished without saving the agreed copy can lose the work. Compare a visible celebratory ending with the practical handoff. Both may matter, but they serve different purposes. The drum image helps when the signal corresponds to something genuinely ready for the next person to receive.
paragraphs.zh: 完成小型共享相册时，有用结尾可能是清楚文件名、分享许可与待补图注说明。无限打磨会让别人用不上；未保存约定版本就宣布完成，又可能丢工作。可分开庆祝结束与实际交接，两者都有意义，却用途不同。鼓的信号应对应真正准备好让下一人接收的东西。

paragraphs.en: When leaving a role or ending a project, distinguish what you can hand over from what others must decide. A concise account of completed work, open questions and available materials may help more than trying to solve every future possibility. Ask which information is actually needed and avoid passing on private details merely because they were part of the process. A good ending can include gratitude without creating an indefinite obligation to remain available. The image supports a respectful boundary between the work finished and the responsibilities that begin elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 离开角色或结束项目时，应分清能交接什么与别人须决定什么。已完成工作、开放问题与可用材料的简要说明，可能比试图解决所有未来情况更有用。应问实际需要何种信息，不因过程接触过就传递私人细节。结束可有感谢，而不制造无限待命义务，让已完工作与他处开始的责任之间有尊重的边界。

title.en: A counterexample that changes the reading

paragraphs.en: A counterexample is an open-ended activity, such as an ongoing collection, that has no natural final version. Another is a task properly ended with a decision not to continue. Neither needs to be forced into a story of triumphant arrival. If this image appeals to you, recall a handoff that made the next step easier and an ending that required leaving a question unanswered. Completion can be practical and partial. A birth position cannot guarantee a safe outcome, decide when a relationship should end or make an uncertain future predictable.
paragraphs.zh: 持续收藏等活动可能没有自然终版，是一种反例；合理结束也可能是决定不再继续。两者无需套进胜利到达故事。可记一次让下一步更容易的交接，以及一次必须保留未答问题的结尾。完成可以实际且局部，出生落点不能保证安全结果、决定关系何时结束或预测未知未来。

paragraphs.en: For an optional experiment, choose a nearly finished low-stakes task and write a three-line handoff: done, still open and where the next useful information is. Include an ending point for your own responsibility if that matters. You do not need a ceremony, a perfect archive or a new promise. The aim is to make the transition understandable. After sharing only with the appropriate people, or keeping the note privately, notice whether anything essential remains unclear. A useful ending may be a modest explanation rather than a feeling of complete certainty or personal transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 可选一项快完成的低风险任务，写三行交接：已完成、仍开放、下一项有用信息在哪里。若相关，也写自己责任的终点，无需仪式、完美档案或新承诺。目的在于让过渡易懂；向适当的人分享或只私存后，看是否还有必要内容不清楚。有用结尾可能只是一份适量说明，不必获得完全确定或个人转化感。

paragraphs.en: For a known birth instant, this calculator transforms the geometric geocentric Moon and a fixed J2000 Spica catalogue direction into the same true ecliptic of date. It subtracts the Spica longitude and adds 180°, then wraps the answer into 0–360°. The unrounded value selects one of 27 equal 13°20′ sectors. Revati occupies sector 27; the displayed pada is one of its four equal subdivisions. Within 0.25° of a mansion edge both adjacent full readings appear. That comparison window is a website policy, not a confidence interval, and does not resolve an inaccurate birth record.
paragraphs.zh: 对已知出生时刻，计算器把几何地心月球和固定J2000角宿一目录方向转换到同一日期真黄道，月球黄经减去角宿一黄经后加180°，再归入0—360°。未舍入值决定27个各13°20′区段中的落点；Revati为第27区段，显示的pada是该区段的四个等分之一。距宿边界不超过0.25°时，同时呈现相邻两篇全文。比较窗口是网站规则，不是置信区间，也无法消除出生记录的不准确。

paragraphs.en: Read this Revati image as an invitation to compare situations, including ones in which it fits poorly. An astronomical position does not establish an instinct, a hidden identity or a future event. This fixed-Spica approximation omits stellar proper motion, aberration and parallax and is not certified as exact Lahiri, Swiss True Chitra or an IMD almanac. A birthplace-specific historical IANA zone is needed to resolve local time; coordinates do not enter this geocentric model. Unknown time receives no substitute noon. No health, marriage, ability or career conclusion follows from this guide. All 27 readings stay open without entering birth details.
paragraphs.zh: 把Revati意象用作比较具体情境的邀请，也纳入不吻合的例子。天文位置不能证明本能、隐藏身份或未来事件。本版固定角宿一近似省略恒星自行、光行差和视差，不声称等同精确Lahiri、Swiss True Chitra或印度气象局历书。当地时间须用出生地当时适用的IANA时区解析；经纬度不参与这一地心模型。未知时间不代填中午。这篇指南不推导健康、婚姻、能力或职业结论；全部27篇无需输入出生资料即可阅读。

paragraphs.en: This tool uses 27 equal sidereal sectors of 13°20′, starting with Ashwini and ending with Revati. It computes an explicitly named Spica-reference position: geometric Moon longitude minus the fixed-Spica longitude plus 180°, wrapped into 0–360°. The same true-ecliptic-of-date transform is applied to both directions. This is an independent approximate reference model, not certified exact Lahiri, Swiss True Chitra or an official IMD calculation. Choosing another ayanamsa can change a near-boundary mansion.
paragraphs.zh: 本工具采用从Ashwini到Revati的27个恒星区段，各13°20′。明确命名的Spica参考位置等于几何月球黄经减固定角宿一黄经加180°，归入0—360°；两个方向使用同一日期真黄道转换。这是独立近似参考模型，不声称等同精确Lahiri、Swiss True Chitra或印度气象局官方计算。更换岁差口径可能改变边界附近的宿。

paragraphs.en: Astronomy Engine 2.1.19 GeoMoon supplies the geometric geocentric Moon. SIMBAD’s FK5 epoch/equinox J2000 Spica direction is fixed at RA 13h25m11.58118s, declination−11°09′40.7514″. Stellar proper motion, binary orbital motion, aberration and parallax are omitted. This is a geocentric geometric model, not an apparent topocentric sky position. The displayed ayanamsa is the fixed-reference Spica longitude minus 180°, not Earth’s sidereal rotation time.
paragraphs.zh: Astronomy Engine2.1.19的GeoMoon提供几何地心月球。SIMBAD的FK5历元与分点J2000角宿一方向固定为赤经13h25m11.58118s、赤纬−11°09′40.7514″。模型省略恒星自行、双星轨道运动、光行差与视差。它是几何地心模型，不是观测者处的视位置。显示的岁差偏移为固定参考角宿一黄经减180°，不是地球自转的恒星时。

title.en: Known birth time and birthplace zone
title.zh: 已知出生时间与出生地时区

paragraphs.en: Use an actual Gregorian local birth date from 1900 through this device’s current instant, a known 24-hour hour-and-minute time, and the birthplace-specific IANA zone applicable on that date. The zone is not inferred from language, browser, coordinates or a current UTC offset. A clock gap is rejected; a repeated minute requires an explicit earlier/later occurrence. Unknown time is not replaced by noon. Historical civil-time records and installed zone data may differ or be incomplete, especially before 1970. Birthplace contributes through civil-time conversion; this geocentric model needs no coordinates, address or geolocation permission.
paragraphs.zh: 使用1900年至设备当前时刻之间真实存在的当地公历出生日期、已知的24小时小时分钟，以及出生地在该日期适用的IANA时区。不按语言、浏览器、经纬度或当前UTC偏移猜时区。不存在的钟表时间会拒算；重复的一分钟须明确选第一次或第二次；未知时间不代填中午。历史民用时间记录与设备时区库可能有差异或不完整，尤其是1970年前。出生地通过民用时间换算参与；地心模型无需坐标、地址或定位许可。

paragraphs.en: Unrounded longitude selects half-open sectors and one of four equal padas; only afterward are displayed degrees truncated downward to two decimals. Padas are subdivisions, not four personality outcomes. At a mansion edge the next sector contains the exact edge value. Within 0.25° of either edge, both adjacent complete guides are shown. This fixed website comparison window is not a calibrated confidence interval, a physical error bound or a guarantee about the birth record. Outside the window, a single displayed sector is still conditional on the supplied time and chosen model.
paragraphs.zh: 先用未舍入黄经确定左闭右开的宿区段和四个等分pada之一，再把显示度数向下截取到两位小数。Pada是区段细分，不是四种人格。恰好位于宿边界的值归后一区段。距离任一宿边界不超过0.25°时，两篇相邻完整指南同时显示。固定比较窗口是网站规则，不是校准后的置信区间、物理误差界或出生记录保证；窗口外的一宿结果同样依赖输入时间与所选模型。

paragraphs.en: The selected IGNOU tables supply traditional symbol variants and gana; practitioner teaching material supplies the Vimshottari ruler cycle and Shravana ear variant. Other sources can use different symbols. Vimshottari rulers, deities, zodiac-sign rulers and yoni animals are distinct categories. Ketu and Rahu name lunar nodes, not physical planets; the Sun is a star and the Moon a satellite. Gana is a traditional classification, without a moral or social ranking here. Each of the 27 eight-section guides adds FermatMind’s original scenes and counterexamples, without claiming that the birth position validates them.
paragraphs.zh: 所选IGNOU表格提供传统符号变体与gana；从业者教学资料提供Vimshottari主星循环及Shravana耳朵变体。其他来源可以使用不同符号。Vimshottari主星、神祇、星座主星和yoni动物是不同类别。计都与罗睺指月球交点，不是实体行星；太阳是恒星，月亮是卫星。本工具不把传统gana分类用于道德或社会等级评定。27篇八节指南补充费马原创场景与反例，不声称出生落点验证这些解释。

paragraphs.en: The geometric Moon calculation was compared with NASA/JPL Horizons geocentric geometric vectors at 1,522 monthly instants from January 1900 through October 2026. The largest sampled angular difference was about 0.070 arcminute. This checks sampled Moon positions, not every instant, the entire reference convention, the birth record or symbolic interpretations. The same ecliptic rotation was used on both sets of vectors; it was not independently validated by that comparison. The display’s decimal places are not an accuracy promise.
paragraphs.zh: 几何月球计算已与NASA/JPL Horizons地心几何向量对照，样本为1900年1月至2026年10月的1,522个月度时刻，采样最大角差约0.070角分。它核查的是采样月球位置，不是每个时刻、整个参考口径、出生记录或符号解释。两组向量采用同一黄道旋转，因此这次对照没有独立验证旋转本身。数字的小数位数不承诺同等精度。

paragraphs.en: Birth fields and results live only in this page’s memory. Clearing, leaving, reloading or changing language removes them. Inputs are not read from query strings or browser storage, sent to an API, included in analytics or copied into public links. Copying supplies only the fixed calculator and 27 guide URLs; public images contain editorial text. A browser or device may independently manage form history or screenshots; this tool cannot control those external records.
paragraphs.zh: 出生字段与结果仅驻留本页内存。清除、离开、刷新或切换语言会移除；不从查询参数或浏览器存储恢复，不发到API，不进入分析事件或公开链接。复制只提供固定计算器与27篇指南网址；公开图片仅含编辑文本。浏览器或设备可能独立管理表单历史与截图，本工具无法控制这些外部记录。

paragraphs.en: A computed position can be reproducible without a personality interpretation being valid. Treat each symbol as an optional comparison with lived experience and allow mismatches. No health, relationship, marriage, fertility, career, wealth or fate conclusion is generated. This calculator does not provide dasha forecasts, auspicious timing, partner matching, houses or an Ascendant. You can read every full guide without entering any birth information.
paragraphs.zh: 计算位置可复现，不代表人格解释有效。可以把符号当作可选的体验比较，也允许不吻合。不生成健康、关系、婚姻、生育、职业、财富或命运结论；不提供大运预测、吉时、配对、宫位或上升点。全部完整指南无需输入任何出生资料即可阅读。

answer.en: It is a known-time cultural calculator with 27 public symbolic guides. It has no psychological question bank, score, norm or validated personality assignment.
answer.zh: 这是已知时间文化计算器，附27篇公开符号指南，没有心理题库、分数、常模或经过验证的人格归类。

question.en: Why might another calculator give a different star?
question.zh: 为什么其他计算器可能给出不同出生宿？

answer.en: Ayanamsa convention, geometric versus apparent coordinates, time-zone history and birth-time precision can all affect the position. This edition names its fixed-Spica approximation and retains adjacent guides near an edge; it does not claim every convention agrees.
answer.zh: 岁差口径、几何或视坐标、时区历史与出生时间精度都可能影响落点。本版明确采用固定角宿一近似，并在边界附近保留相邻指南，不声称各口径一致。

question.en: Can I use an unknown time?

answer.en: No birth star is calculated without a known time, and noon is never substituted. Read all 27 complete guides instead.
answer.zh: 未知时间不计算出生宿，也不代填中午；可以直接阅读全部27篇完整指南。

question.en: Why does the birthplace field ask for a time zone?
question.zh: 为什么出生地字段填写时区？

answer.en: This model uses the Earth’s center. A birthplace-specific historical IANA zone converts the local clock to a UTC instant. At the same instant the geocentric Moon is the same worldwide; coordinates would be needed for a different topocentric calculation.
answer.zh: 本模型以地球中心为基点，通过出生地当时的IANA时区把当地钟表解析为UTC。同一时刻的地心月球位置在全球相同；另一种地平视位置计算才需要坐标。

question.en: What do the two readings near a boundary mean?
question.zh: 边界附近显示两篇是什么意思？

answer.en: The position is within the website’s 0.25° comparison window. Both adjacent full guides remain visible. This is not a confidence interval or evidence for two personality types.
answer.zh: 落点进入网站0.25°比较窗口，两篇相邻全文都保留；这不是置信区间，也不是两种人格的证据。

answer.en: No. Vimshottari uses traditional names including the Sun, Moon, Ketu and Rahu. Astronomically the Sun is a star, the Moon a satellite and Ketu/Rahu lunar nodes. This tool generates no dasha or planetary prediction.
answer.zh: 不是。Vimshottari传统名称包括太阳、月亮、计都与罗睺；按天文学分类，太阳是恒星、月亮是卫星，计都与罗睺是月球交点。本工具不生成大运或行星预测。

question.en: Does gana rank character or compatibility?

answer.en: It is displayed only as a traditional source category. This edition does not turn it into a moral rank, social category, gender rule or marriage score.
answer.zh: 这里只展示它作为传统资料分类，不据此生成人品高低、社会类别、性别规则或婚配分数。

question.en: Can I share my birth inputs or calculated values?
question.zh: 分享会包含出生输入或计算数值吗？

answer.en: The copy button supplies only public calculator and guide URLs. Birth inputs, UTC instants, positions and matched readings are not inserted into copied links or public images.
answer.zh: 复制按钮只提供公开计算器与指南网址，出生输入、UTC时刻、数值落点及个人匹配均不进入复制链接或公开图片。
